title: Google Ads Strategy for Pest Control Companies | INSIDEA

facts.fact: The vendor states that cost per click on high-intent pest control search terms can range from $8 to $30, depending on location and competition.
facts.quote: Cost per click on high-intent terms can range from $8 to $30, depending on location and competition.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends switching from manual CPC or Target Impression Share bidding to Target CPA or Maximize Conversions once at least 30-50 conversions have been tracked.
facts.quote: Once you have at least 30-50 conversions tracked, switch to Target CPA (cost per acquisition) or Maximize Conversions bidding.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends writing at least 8-10 headlines and 3-4 descriptions for Responsive Search Ads.
facts.quote: Write at least 8-10 headlines and 3-4 descriptions so the system has real options to work with.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends counting only phone calls lasting longer than 60 seconds as call conversions.
facts.quote: Set up call conversion tracking to count calls that last longer than 60 seconds.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends reviewing the Search Terms report weekly during the first month of a campaign.
facts.quote: Review your Search Terms report weekly in the first month.

facts.fact: The vendor suggests a pest control Google Ads structure of four campaigns, starting with a Termite Control campaign.
facts.quote: Campaign 1: Termite Control (includes inspection, treatment, and prevention queries)

facts.fact: The vendor advises reviewing hourly performance data after a few weeks and reducing bids or pausing ads during hours with high click volume but no conversions.
facts.quote: Review your hourly performance data after a few weeks and reduce bids or pause ads during hours with high click volume but no conversions.

facts.fact: The vendor advises that Google Ads location targeting should match the actual service area, using radius targeting around the office or manually selected zip codes and cities, and excluding areas not covered.
facts.quote: Location targeting should match your actual service area.

facts.fact: The vendor's recommended foundation for pest control Google Ads accounts includes separate campaigns by service, a thorough negative keyword list, tracking of calls and form submissions, and regular review of performance data.
facts.quote: separate campaigns by service, use specific keywords, build a thorough negative keyword list, track calls and form submissions, and regularly review performance data.
